name: autodrawflowchart
description: AI 智能绘图工具 — 自然语言生成可编辑的 draw.io 流程图 / 架构图 / 思维导图

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('fs').accessSync('web/public/drawio/index.html');console.log('[setup] vendored draw.io editor present')}catch{console.log('[setup] vendored draw.io editor MISSING - run: npm run setup')}"
scripts.dev:vite: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm run dev:vite --workspace web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:all && node tools/verify.mjs
